long_biography.plain_text:
While studying production engineering and economics, Kober joined Raymond Kober and Klaus Weinmann in building CANCOM from 1992. He spent thirteen years on its management board, overseeing sales and marketing as the company grew into one of Germany’s largest IT systems houses. In 2006 he moved into third-generation management at AL-KO, the industrial group founded by his grandfather.

At AL-KO, Kober became chief executive and then chaired its supervisory board during the group’s transition into the PRIMEPULSE network. He also held supervisory leadership at CANCOM and several technology companies. As a PRIMEPULSE co-founder and partner, he now combines those operating, governance and investment perspectives when working with portfolio businesses.
